newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat mixed, new crop up on weather.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat mixed, new crop up on weather.

text.p: Old crop LIFFE wheat futures fell on sentiment that there is more still available than expected, while the new crop rose on continued weather-based fears, traders said.
Trading was slow, in comparison with the active start to the week, they said.
A steady sterling helped bring prices back from their highs of the day in the final stages of trading, one trader said.
He noted that May's low of the day, 92.75 stg, was within 0.10 stg of the contract low, after a sell off which has lasted since the start of April.
July was most active, with 254 lots of a total 601. It last traded 0.75 stg lower at 95.70.
But the new crop months were all up, all by 0.25 stg, with November last traded at 95.50 stg on volume of 140 lots.
There was no trade at all in barley.
